source.datum: Earth geographic plate carree centered on 0 longitude; north at top
source.credit: NASA Earth Observatory; Reto Stockli; MODIS science team

derived.colorSpace: sRGB encoded display RGB; linear-light resize then sRGB encode; import UE sRGB=true
derived.process: sRGB decode, per-channel linear-light Lanczos resize from 21600x10800 to 16384x8192, sRGB encode, JPEG quality 96 4:4:4; no tone mapping, cloud synthesis, sharpening, georegistration, or invented resolution.
derived.resamplingLimit: POT/mip compatibility and improved source retention only; upsampling adds no observed detail.

runtime.photoOverride: Optional higher-resolution base-color candidate; root decides material instance binding after import readback.
runtime.lighting: Keep existing Sun lighting, exposure, atmosphere, cloud/night layers, fixed epoch and physical Earth radius.
runtime.scientificLimit: Historical cloud-free visual composite; source RGB is not calibrated reflectance or current weather.

artifacts.role: source/derived visual audit; not a game capture
